_source: Ryan Boren's list of channels for the screen in the keepers' hut at All Needs Met, 2026-10-11, in his order. Each channel id was read off the channel's own page (its canonical link and its externalId, which agreed) on 2026-10-11. Filled by tools/pull-nature-month.py sanctuary on the morning timer (tools/daily-sanctuary.sh): the latest month of each channel's videos and shorts. Do not hand-edit the log.
_log: A video is an id, the channel it came from, whether it is long-form or a short, its title as written, when it was published, its state (screen, door, pending or gone), why if it is a door, how long it runs, and its channel's name as YouTube gives it. Nothing else: no description, no thumbnail, no count of any kind.
